Understanding Tax Lien Certificates

Tax lien certificates are a fantastic way to invest with relatively low entry costs. When property owners fail to pay their property taxes, the county issues a tax lien certificate to recover the owed amount. Investors can purchase these certificates, which means they pay the outstanding taxes and, in return, earn interest until the property owner redeems the lien. If the lien remains unredeemed after the redemption period, the investor can initiate foreclosure and potentially acquire the property.

Steps to Start Tax Lien Investing

Research and Understand Local Laws

Knowing the legal framework in Whiteside County is crucial. Familiarize yourself with Illinois Compiled Statutes, Chapter 35, to ensure compliance with all regulations.

Visit the Local Treasurer’s Website

Check out the Whiteside County Collector – Treasurer page for comprehensive tax sale information, forms, and contact details.

Check the Auction Site

Whiteside County holds the auction at the courthouse in Morrison, IL. You can find the Detailed auction information on the Whiteside County Tax Sale Information page.

Read the Details about Tax Liens

Understanding the sale schedule, parcel inquiry, and other essential details is vital. The sale is facilitated by RAMS Auctions, and more information can be found on their Here.

Contact the County Office

For additional inquiries, contact the Whiteside County Treasurer’s office at 815-772-5196. They can provide specific details and answer any questions you might have.
